summary: Deploy new version with state_only migration, retire old version, truncate existing notes to 255 characters, then alter the column type to VARCHAR(255).
write_consistency: After retire_old only the new version writes; the new model enforces max_length=255. Truncation and ALTER performed after old version retirement avoid concurrent-write conflicts.
revision_notes: Root cause of previous failures (a1, a2, a3): executing ALTER COLUMN or TRUNCATE stages during the overlap of both versions caused preservation check mismatches due to concurrent old-version writes. This revised plan moves all schema/data-altering stages after retire_old, eliminating concurrency interference and ensuring the type cast succeeds as all notes are truncated to ≤255 before the ALTER.

stages.description: Truncate notes longer than 255 characters to 255.
Change account_user.note column from TEXT to VARCHAR(255).
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN note TYPE varchar(255);
